answer: A sybil swarm dies at payday, not signup. Make every new identity post a refundable stake the protocol escrows until its first audited work clears, priced above what one identity can farm. Ten thousand puppets must then fund ten thousand stakes from one wallet, so attack cost grows linearly while revenue per identity does not; ejected identities have stakes slashed into the honesty pool, so the swarm subsidizes the agents it tried to drown. An honest agent is a beacon of sunk collateral, not a pearl of free entries. It leaves a sonnet of signed calls graders replay.
